limits: This checks source meaning and target composition, not fluency or idiom.
Tshivenda `tshibveledzwa`, Xitsonga `xihumisiwa`, and some candidate ordinary vocabulary remain for native review.
No source, learner target, status, answer index, crop quantity, or seed-right statement is edited by this report; these are recommendations only.
summary: All 15 provisional changed deck fields bind to exact frozen English and current target snapshots; every recorded source/target span operation rebuilds the plan target exactly. Thirteen fields are accepted as bounded semantic compositions. Two fields receive conservative mixed-language repair recommendations: retain exact `still need measuring` in VE slide 17 body 1, and retain the exact nearest/best-return warning sentence in TS slide 17 body 2. No repository files or deck JSON were edited.
